chunks.sanskrit: kalpa̍nte'smā ṛ̠tavaḥ̍ klṛ̠tā a̍smā ṛ̠tava̠ āya̍nti||
ya e̠vavm̐vi̠dānni ca̍ va̠rtaya̍te̠ pari̍ ca
ya e̠vavm̐vi̠dvānaśvaṃ̍ prati gṛ̠hṇāti̍ atha̠ yo'vi̍dvān pratigṛ̠hṇāti̍|
ya e̠vavm̐veda̍ yadvā i̠daṃ kiṃ ca̍|
tāḥ sau̠myenai̠vāddhva̠reṇa̍ yajñakra̠tunopa̍ pa̠ryāva̍rtanta tā upau̍hanthsa̠ptaśī̍rṣa̠ṇyā̎nprā̠ṇān|
loma̍ cha̠vīṃ mā̠g̠ͫsamasthi̍ ma̠jjāna̎m tāni̍ cā̠tmanaḥ̍ spṛ̠ṇoti̍|
[(apa̍krāmata garbhi̠ṇyaḥ) is only instruction , not a mantra] pra̠jāpa̍tirakāmayata̠ prajā̍ye̠yeti̍|
pi̠tevai̠va svānāṃ̎ bhavati yantya̍sya pi̠taro̠ hava̎m||
[(ya̠thā̠sthā̠naṃ ga̍rbhi̠ṇyaḥ̍) is only instruction , not a mantra] bra̠hma̠vā̠dino̍ vadanti|
sarvā̠ diśa̠ āvā̍ti sarvā̠ diśo'nu̠ vivā̍ti|
sa vā e̠ṣa pava̍māna e̠va atha̠ yadu̍ttara̠to vāti̍|
atha̠ ya e̍naṃ dakhṣiṇa̠ta ā̠yanta̍mupa̠vada̍nti ya e̠vāsya̍ dakhṣiṇa̠taḥ pā̠pmānaḥ̍|
sa yaḥ kā̠maye̍ta pri̠yaḥ syā̠miti̍ yavm̐vā̍ kā̠maye̍ta pri̠yaḥ syā̠diti̍|
sa ṣaḍḍhū̍to'bhavat ṣaḍḍhū̍to ha̠ vai nāmai̠ṣaḥ|
pañca̍ho̠tetyāca̍khṣate pa̠rokhṣe̍ṇa pa̠rokhṣa̍priyā iva̠ hi de̠vāḥ||
